article.title: Build specialized multimodal models with LFM3

harvestedTerms.summary: Liquid AI announces LFM3, a new family of small multimodal foundation models (~2B parameters) built on a tri-hybrid architecture (gated short convolutions + sliding-window attention + global attention) optimized for edge deployment and agentic tasks. The release covers six model variants spanning text, vision, audio, omni, and decision modalities, all fine-tunable on a single GPU. Key architectural innovations include partial RoPE, head-wise gated attention, sandwich norm, and a novel audio codec (LiquidCodec).

article.title: Researchers are getting tired of OpenAI gatekeeping its breakthroughs

harvestedTerms.summary: OpenAI announces breakthroughs in mathematics, computer science, and physics — including a purported resolution of the Kakeya conjecture and a disproof of the exponential time hypothesis — but researchers criticise the company's 'shepherd' system for controlling access and handpicking which experts may evaluate results before public release.

mustReadFlagged.reason: A substantive account of a new tension in AI's relationship to scientific institutions: as AI labs generate genuine mathematical and physics breakthroughs, their control over disclosure creates a novel power asymmetry with research communities. The 'shepherd' system described here is a genuinely new governance pattern, and the researcher frustration is a real signal about how norms of open science are being renegotiated in real time.

article.title: Anthropic files S-1 with the SEC for proposed initial public offering

The announcement is a brief legal notice with no prospectus details yet disclosed, naming Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley as underwriters. The article contains minimal substantive AI terminology.
